text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even without a blazing passion, Wonder 
Acute ran a strong race purely on her true 
grit.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It warms my heart. To see so many people 
cheering for me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right... There are wonderful 
Umamusume on dirt too, and they've been 
working hard all this time, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Falco-san isn't here right now, but that's 
all the more reason why...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Isn't there something I oughta be doing?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Trainer. I just had an idea, 
y'know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"What do you think...? What if I... became 
a storyteller for the dirt tracks?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Falco-san is an amazing 
Umamusume, but while she's away, no one 
can run with her, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So... I figured I'd be the one to pass 
down the tale of how amazing she was.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course, she was a sparkling 
Umamusume who would've blown even Snow 
White away...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I have to tell the girls who come after 
me."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there are things that even I can do. 
Even if...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Even if I were to quit running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It seems her passion hasn't been 
reignited... Wonder Acute, that is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm turning into an old woman telling 
tales of the past. Gathering up memories 
scooped from the dirt...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still... even so...
choice_data_list:
Next up, let's go with the 『JBC 
Classic』.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? ...'JBC Classic'?"
choice_data_list:
I still need to gather more material for 
old stories!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute smiles warmly. But she won't 
even say "let's do that" anymore. At this 
rate...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She wouldn't even last until the 'JBC 
Classic' in the fall at this rate. A late 
summer of no return was about to begin...
